objects.description: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has obtained and used tools such as [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357), [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002), and [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029).(Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021)
